## Lib/eacp/GPU/Codegen/ShaderGraph.h

- enum class `ExprKind` — eacp::GPU — ShaderGraph.h:17
  - `Input` = 0 — vertex attribute; index = attribute slot
  - `Varying` = 1 — fragment-stage read of a varying; index = varying slot
  - `Uniform` = 2 — per-frame constant; index = field slot in the uniform block
  - `Constant` = 3 — scalar float literal; value
  - `Construct` = 4 — floatN(args...); args = child nodes
  - `Swizzle` = 5 — child.<components>; args[0] = child
  - `Call` = 6 — builtin call text(args...); e.g. sin/cos.
  - `Unary` = 7 — (op child); args = {child}; op.
  - `Binary` = 8 — (lhs op rhs); args = {lhs, rhs}.
  - `Compare` = 9 — (lhs op rhs) yielding a Bool; args = {lhs, rhs}, op text in `text`.
  - `Select` = 10 — (condition ? whenTrue : whenFalse); args = {condition, a, b}.
  - `VarRead` = 11 — the current value of a mutable local; index = variable slot.
  - `Mul` = 12 — a matrix product: args = {left, right} in the order written, which
  - `Sample` = 13 — texture sample; index = texture slot, args = {uv} or {uv, level}.
